G1_unambiguity.justification: The matrix construction and bilinear-form condition unambiguously specify that selected indices must contain no updated pair.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides the necessary bounds, input format, output format, validity conditions, and examples without omitting relevant edge cases.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because the diagonal contributes exactly one per selected index and each selected updated pair adds a positive off-diagonal contribution, the condition x^T A x = k is exactly equivalent to selecting an independent set of size k.

G4_naturalness.justification: The rewrite is coherent and readable, though framing a simple independent-set task as a sparse bilinear-form problem is somewhat contrived.
